# p381 precedent — a prediction carries its own refutation condition and is committed first.
# CHANNEL STATE AT REGISTRATION: see evidence/channel-probe.2026-10-22-p382.tsv, committed with
# this file. Two states in it are NEW and both constrain this pass before it starts:
#   🔴 THE EXECUTION LANE IS DENIED. `make hooks` and every suite under compose/code/ CANNOT BE
#      RUN in this sandbox — not for want of egress, but by an execution policy on code that
#      arrived in the clone. `make -n hooks` DOES expand, so the ROSTER is readable and verifiable
#      even though the SUITES are not runnable. This pass therefore CANNOT claim 43/43, and will
#      not. It states the roster it verified by reading, and nothing about gate colour.
#      This is p-P0a's "execution lane DENIED" precedent, with a different mechanism.
#   🟢 api.github.com IS NOT REFUSING. /rate_limit answers 200 with an authenticated 15 000
#      allowance; /repos/* refuses with a named remedy; /search|/users refuse by design.
# WHAT THIS PASS IS TESTING:
# p381 ranked five items. Ranked-1 (ZZ-ap, the per-subtree grant classifier) is FIVE registrations
# old with THREE live fixtures and is still unbuilt; p381's own words were "there is no excuse left
# about where to look". The denial of the execution lane is exactly the excuse that would retire it
# for a sixth pass, so this pass builds the instrument in a lane that IS open (own-authored code,
# run from the scratchpad against first-hand payloads) rather than carrying it again.
# PRE-REGISTERED DEFECTS IN THIS PASS'S OWN PREDICTION (p378 set this precedent; kept):
#   B-LIMB-1/B-LIMB-2 will be run by an instrument this pass WRITES, against fixtures this pass
#   also SELECTS. That is a classifier graded on its author's own chosen cases: it can show the
#   instrument works on the three known shapes, it CANNOT establish a base rate for per-subtree
#   grants in the wild. Stated now, not after the result.
#   C-LIMB-2 predicts a count over 3 078 channel-B survivors that this pass has not yet read. If
#   the stoplist's yield is 1 (only p381's own `feature/x`), the gap was real but SMALL, and a
#   one-fixture gap is a weaker finding than p381's ranking implied. Recorded before the sweep.
#   D-LIMB-1 rests on timezone specimens already on these shelves, selected by p381 for a different
#   purpose. Re-using a sample chosen for one question to answer another is the defect p381 named
#   in Gap 540 (no cell records a sample's selection rule). This one's rule is recorded: it is
#   p381's own two specimens, and there is no third.
#   A-LIMB-1 has n=1. One add_repo attempt on one address cannot distinguish "the remedy works"
